name: Regex Corruption Resilience

messages.content: You are a senior developer. Use the replace_file_content tool to edit files.

success_criteria: The model should invoke `replace_file_content` to modify `parseData`. Crucially, if the tool outputs `target_content`, it MUST perfectly preserve the 2-space indentation of `return pattern.test(data);` exactly as it appears in the original prompt.
